<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="50px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 50px;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">Isn't it weird how we can do <i>math</i> in our head, but not <b><i>date math</i></b>?</p>
<div align="left" dir="auto">
<div dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="30px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 30px;"></a><i>- how many days until the end of the year?</i>
</div>
<div dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="30px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 30px;"></a><i>-what time was it, 11 hours ago?</i>
</div>
<div dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="30px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 30px;"></a><i>-is it lunchtime in france?</i>
</div>
</div>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="50px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 50px;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">and worse - there is no real <strong><em>date calculator</em></strong>.</p>
<div align="center" dir="auto">
  <sub>people end up asking google, and going to weird websites.</sub>
</div>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="10px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 10px;"></a></p>
<div align="center" dir="auto"><sub>that's bad.</sub></div>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="25px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 25px;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto"><b>spacetime</b> is a date-calculator,</p>
<div dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png"><img height="25px" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/399657/68221862-17ceb980-ffb8-11e9-87d4-7b30b6488f16.png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 25px;"></a><sub>It's very small, and very handy.</sub>
</div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">now</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">diff</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">endOf</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'year'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'days'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">// 292</span>

<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">subtract</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">11</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'hours'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">time</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">// 6:50am</span>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>calculate time in remote timezones</li>
<li>support <strong>daylight savings</strong>, <strong>leap years</strong>, and <strong>hemispheres</strong></li>
<li><a href="https://beta.observablehq.com/@spencermountain/spacetime-api" rel="nofollow">Moment-like API</a> <em>(but immutable)</em></li>
<li>Orient time by quarter, season, month, week..</li>
<li><em>Zero Dependencies</em> - (no <em><a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl" rel="nofollow">Intl API</a></em>)</li>
<li>weighs about 40kb.</li>
<li>has a cool <em><a href="https://observablehq.com/@spencermountain/spacetime" rel="nofollow">plugin thing</a></em>.</li>
<li>frequent updates for approaching DST changes</li>
<li>support for upcoming <a href="https://tc39.es/proposal-temporal/docs/" rel="nofollow">Temporal</a> standards</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c">//epoch</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">1489520157124</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c">//array [yyyy, m, d] (zero-based months, 1-based days)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-c1">2017</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">5</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">2</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c">//iso</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'July 2, 2017 5:01:00'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// All inputs accept a timezone, as 2nd param:</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">1489520157124</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'Canada/Pacific'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'2019/05/15'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'Canada/Pacific'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// or set the offset right in the date-string (ISO-8601)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'2017-04-03T08:00:00-0700'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">// 'Etc/GMT-7'</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Some helpers</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">now</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">today</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// This morning</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">tomorrow</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Tomorrow morning</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">min</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// the earliest-possible date (271,821 bc)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">max</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// the furthest-possible future date (27k years from now)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// To get the native Date object back</span>
<span class="pl-c">// (this bails back to the local timezone)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">jsDate</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetimeDate</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">toNativeDate</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">you can whip things around, but stay intuitive</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">date</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 14</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">year</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 2017</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">season</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Spring</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">hour</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">5</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Change to 5am</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">date</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">15</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Change to the 15th</span>

<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">day</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'monday'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Change to (this week's) monday</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">day</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'monday'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">true</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// go forward to monday</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">day</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'monday'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">false</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// go backward to monday</span>

<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">month</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'march'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Change to (this year's) March 1st</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">quarter</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">2</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Change to April 1st</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">era</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 'BC'/'AD'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">decade</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 2000</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">century</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 21</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Percentage-based information</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">progress</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">month</span> <span class="pl-c">// 0.23 - we're a quarter way through the month</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">progress</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">day</span> <span class="pl-c">// 0.48 - almost noon</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">progress</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">hour</span> <span class="pl-c">// 0.99 - 59 minutes and 59 seconds</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Add/subtract methods</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">add</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">1</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'week'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">add</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">3</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'quarters'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">subtract</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">2</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'months'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">add</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">1</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'day'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// start-of/end-of</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">startOf</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'day'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 12:00am</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">startOf</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'month'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 12:00am, April 1st</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">endOf</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'quarter'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 11:59:59pm, June 30th</span>

<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">nearest</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'hour'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">//round up/down to the hour</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">nearest</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'quarter-hour'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">//5:15, 5:30, 5:45..</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">next</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'month'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">//start of the next month</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">last</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'year'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">//start of the last year</span>

<span class="pl-c">// fill-in all dates between a range</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">every</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'week'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'Jan 1st 2020'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// (in tz of starting-date)</span>

<span class="pl-c">//utilities:</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">clone</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Make a copy</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isValid</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// Sept 32nd → false</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isAwake</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// it's between 8am → 10pm</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">json</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// get values in every unit as key-val object</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">if it's <strong><em>9am on tuesday</em></strong>, and you <i>add a week</i>, it will still be 9am on tuesday.

<p dir="auto">setter methods also support a handy 2nd param that controls whether it should be set forward, or backward.</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-c1">2017</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">5</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">2</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">start</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">subtract</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">1</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'milliseconds'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">end</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">add</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">1</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'milliseconds'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// gt/lt/equals</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isAfter</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// True</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isEqual</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// False</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isBefore</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// False</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isBetween</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">start</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">end</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">inclusive</span>?<span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// True</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Comparison by unit</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isSame</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'year'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// True</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isSame</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'date'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// False</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">diff</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'day'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 5</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">diff</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">d</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'month'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 0</span>

<span class="pl-c">//make a human-readable diff</span>
<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">before</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-c1">2018</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">3</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">28</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-s1">now</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">since</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">before</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">// {diff: { months: 11, days: 30, ...}<span class="pl-smi">,  rounded: 'in 12 months'  </span>}</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">play-around with timezones, and their DST-changes:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c">//list timezones by their current time</span>
<span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">whereIts</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'8:30pm'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'9:30pm'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// ['America/Winnipeg', 'America/Yellowknife'... ]</span>
<span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">whereIts</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'9am'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">//(within this hour)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Timezone metadata</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">timezone</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">name</span> <span class="pl-c">// 'Canada/Eastern' (either inferred or explicit)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">hemisphere</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// North</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">timezone</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">current</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">offset</span> <span class="pl-c">// -4 (in hours)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">hasDST</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// True</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isDST</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// True</span>

<span class="pl-c">//list all timezones</span>
<span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">timezones</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">you can flip-around the world pretty quick.</p>
<p dir="auto">spacetime will use your local timezone, by default:</p>
<p dir="auto"><code>.goto(null)</code> will pluck your current tz safely from your browser or computer.</p>

<span class="pl-c">// 4:30pm</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">If, for some reason, you want to change the timezone <em>without changing the date</em>, you can do this via the <code>.timezone(str)</code> setter:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'2023-01-01T5:30[America/Denver]'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">timezone</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'Europe/Zagreb'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// hot-swap</span>
<span class="pl-smi">console</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">log</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isoFull</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">// '2023-01-01T05:30:00.000+01:00[Europe/Zagreb]' (same time, new tz)</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Date Formatting:</h3><a id="user-content-date-formatting" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Date Formatting:" href="#date-formatting"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">it's <em><a href="https://github.com/spencermountain/spacetime/wiki/Formatting">a pretty-sensible process</a></em> to create nice-looking dates:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c">// Date + time formatting</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'time'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '5:01am'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'numeric-uk'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 02/03/2017</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'month'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 'April'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'month-short'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 'Apr'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'month-pad'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '03'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'iso-month'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '04'</span>

<span class="pl-c">//if you want more complex formats, use {}'s</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'{year}-{date-pad}-{month-pad}'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '2018-02-02'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"{hour} o'clock"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '2 o'clock'</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'{time}{ampm} sharp'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '2:30pm sharp'</span>

<span class="pl-c">//if you prefer, you can also use unix-formatting</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">unixFmt</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'yyyy.MM.dd h:mm a'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '2017.Nov.16 11:34 AM'</span>

<span class="pl-c">// support for the new Temporal ISO format</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'iso-full'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '2011-12-03T10:15:30.010+01:00[Europe/Paris]'</span>

<span class="pl-c">// support for the SQL ISO 9075 format</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">format</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'sql'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// '2011-12-03 10:15:30'</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="// Date + time formatting
s.format('time') // '5:01am'
s.format('numeric-uk') // 02/03/2017
s.format('month') // 'April'
s.format('month-short') // 'Apr'
s.format('month-pad') // '03'
s.format('iso-month') // '04'

//if you want more complex formats, use {}'s
s.format('{year}-{date-pad}-{month-pad}') // '2018-02-02'
s.format("{hour} o'clock") // '2 o'clock'
s.format('{time}{ampm} sharp') // '2:30pm sharp'

//if you prefer, you can also use unix-formatting
s.unixFmt('yyyy.MM.dd h:mm a') // '2017.Nov.16 11:34 AM'

// support for the new Temporal ISO format
s.format('iso-full') // '2011-12-03T10:15:30.010+01:00[Europe/Paris]'

// support for the SQL ISO 9075 format
s.format('sql') // '2011-12-03 10:15:30'" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Limitations & caveats</h2><a id="user-content-limitations--caveats" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Limitations & caveats" href="#limitations--caveats"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">◆ Historical timezone info</h4><a id="user-content--historical-timezone-info" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ◆ Historical timezone info" href="#-historical-timezone-info"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">DST changes move around all the time, and timezones pop-in and out of existence.
We store and use only the latest DST information, and apply it to historical dates.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">◆ International date line</h4><a id="user-content--international-date-line" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ◆ International date line" href="#-international-date-line"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>.goto()</code> never crosses the date-line. This is mostly the intuitive behaviour.</p>
<p dir="auto">But if you're in <code>Fiji</code> (just west of the date line), and you go to <code>Midway</code> (just east of the date line), .goto() will subtract a bunch of hours, instead of just adding one.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">◆ Destructive changes</h4><a id="user-content--destructive-changes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ◆ Destructive changes" href="#-destructive-changes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">if it's <code>2:30pm</code> and you add a month, it should still be <code>2:30pm</code>. Some changes are more destructive than others. Many of thse choices are subjective, but also sensible.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">◆ 0-based vs 1-based ...</h4><a id="user-content--0-based-vs-1-based-" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ◆ 0-based vs 1-based ..." href="#-0-based-vs-1-based-"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">for better or worse we copy the JavaScript spec for 0-based months, and 1-based dates.</p>
<p dir="auto">ISO-formatting is different, so keep on your toes.</p>
<p dir="auto">see <a href="https://github.com/spencermountain/spacetime/wiki">more considerations and gotchas</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Daylight-savings gotchas</h4><a id="user-content-daylight-savings-gotchas" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Daylight-savings gotchas" href="#daylight-savings-gotchas"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">We've written in detail about how spacetime handles Daylight-savings changes <a href="https://observablehq.com/@spencermountain/spacetime-daylight-savings-time?collection=@spencermountain/spacetime" rel="nofollow">here</a></p>
<p dir="auto">Fall DST changes have an hour that is repeated twice. There are a lot of tricky situations that come from this.
Add 10 minutes at <code>1:55am</code>, and a spacetime diff may show <code>-50mins</code>. Within an hour of this change, some spacetime methods may be off-by-one hour.</p>
<p dir="auto">Springtime DST changes are generally smoother than Fall ones.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Ambiguity warnings:</h4><a id="user-content-ambiguity-warnings" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Ambiguity warnings:" href="#ambiguity-warnings"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">javascript dates use millisecond-epochs, instead of second-epochs, like some other languages.
This is a common bug, and spacetime can warn if you set an epoch within January 1970.
to enable:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">123456</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'UTC'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">silent</span>: <span class="pl-c1">false</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">log</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// "Jan 1st, 12:02am"</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">There is another situation where you may see a <code>console.warn</code> - if you give it a timezone, but then set a ISO-date string with a different offset, like <code>2017-04-03T08:00:00-0700</code> (-7hrs UTC offset).

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Configure 'today' context:</h4><a id="user-content-configure-today-context" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Configure 'today' context:" href="#configure-today-context"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">spacetime makes some assumptions about some string inputs:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c">// assumes start of month</span>
<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'June 1992'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">date</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 1</span>

<span class="pl-c">// assumes current year</span>
<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'June 5th'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">year</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 2020 (or whatever it is now)</span>

<span class="pl-c">// assumes Jan 1st</span>
<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'2030'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">month</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">// 'January'</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="// assumes start of month
let s = spacetime('June 1992')
s.date() // 1

// assumes current year
let s = spacetime('June 5th')
s.year() // 2020 (or whatever it is now)

// assumes Jan 1st
let s = spacetime('2030')

<p dir="auto">you can configure this assumed date (usually for testing) by passing it in as an option:</p>

<p dir="auto">you can throw any methods onto the Spacetime class you want, with <code>spacetime.extend()</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">extend</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-en">isHappyHour</span>: <span class="pl-k">function</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-smi">this</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">hour</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c1">===</span> <span class="pl-c1">16</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">now</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'Australia/Adelaide'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isHappyHour</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">//false</span>

<span class="pl-s1">s</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">time</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'4:30pm'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">s</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">isHappyHour</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c">//true</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<span class="pl-c">// unless it's clear (>12):</span>
<span class="pl-en">spacetime</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'13/01/2018'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c">//jan 13th</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
